sentences.zh: 一排排两层的红砖双拼房屋沿着山坡建造，一面俯瞰斯潘谷，另一面俯瞰德斯伯里。

sentences.zh: 德斯伯里曾被称为约克郡重毛纺织业的中心，主要生产用于绳索、毯子和军服的重型羊毛纺织品，

sentences.en: and the whole area, including Moorside Estate, benefited from the seemingly endless factory work.

sentences.zh: 莫尔赛德就像梦想成真一样。

sentences.en: Many people who had come from the cities or nearby towns where their homes were old and cramped felt the immense space and safety of Moorside.
sentences.zh: 许多来自城市或附近城镇、住所古老而逼仄的人们，都感受到了莫尔赛德那巨大的空间感和安全性。

sentences.en: From its early days, the community was strong and supportive of each other.
sentences.zh: 从早期开始，这个社区就非常团结，彼此守望相助。

sentences.en: They struggled together through the closing of the mills, World War II, and the hard times that followed.
sentences.zh: 他们一起挺过了工厂倒闭、二战以及随之而来的艰难岁月。

sentences.en: The decades that followed were tough, and by the 1970s, the only working mills left were bedding and biscuit manufacturers.
sentences.zh: 随后的几十年十分艰难，到20世纪70年代，仅存的工厂只剩下床品和饼干制造商了。

sentences.en: Buses on the estate took fewer and fewer workers into town, and people were forced to find whatever work they could to feed their families.
sentences.zh: 庄园里的公交车载着越来越少的工人进城，人们被迫四处寻找能养家糊口的工作。

sentences.en: Some turned to crime.
sentences.zh: 有些人走上了犯罪道路。

sentences.en: By the 1980s, things were grim, and criminal and social difficulties were a serious problem.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪80年代，情况变得十分严峻，犯罪和社会问题成了严重的问题。

sentences.en: Much of the youth saw their parents unemployed, and in turn, grew up without a trade or a reason to work.

sentences.en: As Dewsbury got on with revamping disused buildings and factories into apartments and retail,

sentences.zh: 尤其是老年人不再感到安全，入室盗窃事件层出不穷。

sentences.en: The government was about to revamp the area.
sentences.zh: 政府正准备改造这个地区。

sentences.zh: 德斯伯里莫尔上的住宅区（包括莫尔赛德）的入室盗窃率是全国平均水平的两倍。

sentences.en: Something needed to be done.
sentences.zh: 必须采取行动了。

sentences.en: A new strategy for robust policing was enforced, and plans to upgrade the area were approved.
sentences.zh: 当局实施了一项强力警务的新战略，并批准了升级该地区的计划。

sentences.en: Four million pounds were spent on the regeneration of the estate.
sentences.zh: 四百万英镑被用于该庄园的重建。

sentences.en: Emphasis was placed on slowing down traffic and making the streets safer and more enjoyable for kids.
sentences.zh: 重点放在减缓交通速度以及让街道对孩子们来说更安全、更有趣上。

sentences.en: By adding features such as park benches, tables and play equipment, the government hoped to encourage community interaction.
sentences.zh: 通过增设公园长椅、桌子和游乐设施等配套，政府希望鼓励社区互动。

sentences.en: With the help of some local kids, they came up with fresh ideas for their anti-joyride bollards.
sentences.zh: 在一些当地孩子的帮助下，他们为防冲撞路障想出了新鲜的点子。

sentences.en: These bollards dotted around the estate were built in the shape of penguins, while other bollards replicated fossils.
sentences.zh: 这些散落庄园各处的路障被建成了企鹅的形状，还有一些则模仿化石的造型。

sentences.en: All of these features were designed to calm the area.
sentences.zh: 所有这些设计都是为了让这个地区平静下来。

sentences.en: Money was also spent on upgrading dilapidated homes, with new fences, roofs, and windows.
sentences.zh: 资金还用于翻修破旧的房屋，包括安装新的栅栏、屋顶和窗户。

sentences.zh: 到2008年，莫尔赛德庄园在公屋登记册上成了抢手货。

sentences.en: But the estate hadn't changed overnight.
sentences.zh: 但庄园并没有一夜之间发生巨变。

sentences.en: Most families were still getting by on one income, which was usually minimum wage.
sentences.zh: 大多数家庭仍然靠一份通常是最低工资的单一收入勉强过活。

sentences.en: Many residents had pride in their homes and their newly upgraded surroundings, but others still continued to dump rubbish and furniture in their yards.
sentences.zh: 许多居民为自己的家园和新升级的环境感到骄傲，但也有人依然继续在院子里倾倒垃圾和旧家具。

sentences.zh: 香农的家谱上有数百个名字，他被遗漏掉是有可能的。

sentences.en: Stranger things had happened.
sentences.zh: 比这更离奇的事都发生过。

sentences.zh: 在一次接受媒体采访时，凯伦·马修斯忘了他有七个孩子，当时只记起自己有六个。

sentences.en: So the chance that
sentences.zh: 因此，

sentences.zh: 克雷格的叔叔迈克尔·多诺万被从家谱中遗漏是很有可能的。

sentences.en: Although something of note was, Michael Donovan hadn't turned up to take part in any of the searches for Shannon, despite only living close by.
sentences.zh: 尽管有一点值得注意：尽管就住在附近，但迈克尔·多诺万并没有露面参加任何寻找香农的搜救行动。

sentences.en: Detective Constables Nick Townsend and Paul
sentences.zh: 侦探警员尼克·汤森和保罗

sentences.en: Kettlewell were dispatched to visit Donovan and get his details.
sentences.zh: 凯特尔韦尔被派去拜访多诺万并获取他的详细信息。

sentences.en: They'd spent the last three weeks speaking to all relatives and people who had ties to Shannon.
sentences.zh: 过去三周里，他们一直在与所有亲属以及与香农有联系的人谈话。

sentences.en: They'd completed over 700 door knocks and nothing of any significance had come up.
sentences.zh: 他们已经完成了700多次敲门走访，但没有任何有价值的线索出现。

sentences.en: Donovan lived in Lydgate Gardens, a large estate full of two-storey vanilla brick flats in Bartley Carr, less than one mile from Shannon's home.
sentences.zh: 多诺万住在巴特利卡尔的利德盖特花园，这是一个由许多两层香草色砖墙公寓组成的大型住宅区，距离香农的家不到一英里。

sentences.en: Officers Townsend and Kettlewell arrived at Donovan's estate in the late morning.
sentences.zh: 汤森和凯特尔韦尔警官于深夜上午抵达了多诺万的住宅区。

sentences.en: They walked up the communal stairs to unit number 24 on the first floor.
sentences.zh: 他们走上公共楼梯，来到了二楼（译注：英国的first floor即中国二楼）的24号单元。

sentences.en: They knocked, but no one answered, so they knocked on the neighbour's door.
sentences.zh: 他们敲了门，但无人应答，于是他们敲了邻居的门。

sentences.en: The neighbour told them that Donovan should be home as his car was parked outside and he never went anywhere without it.
sentences.zh: 邻居告诉他们，多诺万应该在家，因为他的车就停在外面，而且他去哪儿都离不开车。

sentences.en: The officers then checked with the downstairs neighbours.
sentences.zh: 警官随后向楼下的邻居进行了核实。

sentences.en: The woman who lived in the flat directly underneath Donovan said she was sure that she had heard him upstairs that morning.
sentences.zh: 住在多诺万公寓正下方的妇女说，她确信那天早上听到他在楼上。

sentences.en: After a few more questions, the woman said that in the last few weeks she had heard the sound of a child's feet shuffling around upstairs.
sentences.zh: 经过进一步询问，这位妇女说，在过去几周里，她听到楼上有小孩拖着脚步走动的声音。

sentences.en: Donovan's kids weren't there anymore, but he did have a new girlfriend, and the neighbour thought his girlfriend must have had a child.
sentences.zh: 多诺万的孩子已经不在那里了，但他确实交了一个新女朋友，这位邻居以为他女朋友一定带了个小孩。

sentences.en: But Townsend and Kettlewell thought otherwise.
sentences.zh: 但汤森和凯特尔韦尔却不这么认为。

sentences.en: They phoned for backup.
sentences.zh: 他们打电话请求支援。

sentences.en: The operational search team arrived, and the group met at the stairs to discuss the plan.
sentences.zh: 行动搜救小组赶到了，一行人在楼梯处碰头讨论计划。

sentences.en: They decided that if
sentences.zh: 他们决定，如果

sentences.en: Donovan was in, and had innocently not heard them knocking, and nothing untoward was found, then that was a risk worth taking.
sentences.zh: 多诺万在里面，而且只是阴差阳错没听到敲门声，并且没有发现什么异常，那么冒这个险是值得的。

sentences.en: They broke Donovan's door down.
sentences.zh: 他们撞开了多诺万的房门。

sentences.en: After going up a small flight of stairs to the living area, they realized the flat was in total silence.
sentences.zh: 走上一小段楼梯来到起居区后，他们发现公寓里一片死寂。

sentences.en: But then one of the officers tried a bedroom door and it was locked.
sentences.zh: 但接着，其中一名警官试了一下卧室的门，发现门锁着。

sentences.en: He opened it with one kick.
sentences.zh: 他一脚把门踢开了。

sentences.en: The smell of cigarette smoke was fresh.
sentences.zh: 烟草味依然很新鲜。

sentences.en: One of the officers put his hand down on the bed and the sheets felt warm.
sentences.zh: 其中一名警官把手按在床上，床单感觉还是温的。

sentences.en: At that moment, they heard the small cry of a child.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，他们听到了孩子细小的哭声。

sentences.en: Stop it, you're frightening me.
sentences.zh: “住手，你吓到我了。”

sentences.zh: 声音闷声闷气的，是从床底下传出来的。他们看了一眼，那张床似乎有

sentences.zh: 坚固的床框。两名警官试图从底座把它抬起来，但它太重了，他们

sentences.zh: 来得及互相对视一眼，一个小女孩就从床底下的抽屉里爬了出来。

sentences.en: she tried to stand but she was confused and dazed kettlewell picked her up and left the room with her safely in his arMs. He asked her where Donovan was.
sentences.zh: 她试图站起来，但她感到困惑和迷茫。凯特尔韦尔抱起她，将她安全地抱在怀里离开了房间。他问她多诺万在哪里。

sentences.en: Where I was, under the bed.
sentences.zh: “我在床底下。”

sentences.en: The other officers bent down and peered through the hole for the drawer.
sentences.zh: 其他警官俯下身，透过抽屉的洞往里看。

sentences.en: Michael Donovan, Craig's uncle, was curled up under the bed in the fetal position.
sentences.zh: 克雷格的叔叔迈克尔·多诺万呈胎儿状蜷缩在床底下。

sentences.en: No amount of yelling at him to come out did any good.
sentences.zh: 无论怎么大喊让他出来都没有用。

sentences.en: They placed him under arrest on suspicion of abduction.
sentences.zh: 他们以涉嫌绑架罪将他逮捕。

sentences.en: Donovan was lying under the bed with 600 pounds in cash, a prescription for Tamazepam, a box of travel sickness medication,
sentences.zh: 多诺万躺在床底下，身边有600英镑现金、一张替马西泮的处方、一盒晕车药、

sentences.en: and the Sun newspaper, with the headline about Shannon's new 50,000 pound reward.
sentences.zh: 以及头条新闻报道香农悬赏金提高到5万英镑的《太阳报》。

sentences.en: From the moment the officers tried to cuff him, and while trying to get him out of the flat into the police car, Donovan kicked and yelled and tried to break free from their grasp.
sentences.zh: 从警官们试图给他戴上手铐的那一刻起，直到把他从公寓带到警车的过程中，多诺万一直在踢打、叫喊，并试图挣脱他们的控制。

sentences.en: Neighbours had gathered downstairs.
sentences.zh: 邻居们聚集在楼下。

sentences.en: They were shocked when Detective Constable Paul Kettlewell walked out of the stairwell holding a girl in his arMs. One neighbour whispered to the officer,
sentences.zh: 当侦探警员保罗·凯特尔韦尔抱着一个女孩走出楼梯间时，他们惊呆了。一位邻居低声问警官：

sentences.en: Is it Shannon?
sentences.zh: “是香农吗？”

sentences.en: Yes, she's okay, Kettlewell replied.
sentences.zh: “是的，她没事，”凯特尔韦尔回答。

sentences.en: As Michael Donovan was dragged on his knees, refusing to walk to the police car, neighbours shouted abuse at him.
sentences.zh: 当迈克尔·多诺万被按着膝盖拖行、拒绝自己走到警车旁时，邻居们对他恶语相向。

sentences.en: He yelled back,
sentences.zh: 他大喊着回击：

sentences.en: Don't hate me.
sentences.zh: “别恨我。”

sentences.en: I'm a poorly man.
sentences.zh: “我是一个生病的人。”

sentences.en: Shannon sat safely in the back of the other police car.
sentences.zh: 香农安稳地坐在另一辆警车的后座上。

sentences.en: Townsend and Kettlewell took a moment to shake each other's hands.
sentences.zh: 汤森和凯特尔韦尔花了一会儿时间互相握手。

sentences.en: they didn't need to say anything they both knew exactly how the other felt
sentences.zh: 他们不需要说什么，双方都清楚对方心里的感受。

sentences.en: they reminded shannon that everything was going to be okay she was safe now when detective
sentences.zh: 他们提醒香农一切都会好起来的，她现在安全了。当侦探

sentences.en: superintendent andy brennan received the call his first reaction was that a body had been found
sentences.zh: 总督察安迪·布伦南接到电话时，他的第一反应是找到了一具尸体。

sentences.en: he had to double check shannon was alive the first thing shannon was given when she arrived back at Dewsbury Police Station was a colouring book and some pencils.
sentences.zh: 他不得不再次确认香农还活着。香农回到迪斯伯里警察局后收到的第一样东西是一本填色册和一些铅笔。

sentences.en: A white tent was set up at the entrance to the communal stairs, and Donovan's flat was searched by crime scene officers who took fingerprints and swabs for DNA.
sentences.zh: 公共楼梯入口处搭建了一个白色帐篷，犯罪现场勘查人员对多诺万的公寓进行了搜查，提取了指纹和DNA拭子。

sentences.en: They found a long fabric strip coming from the manhole in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 他们在过道的检修孔里发现了一条长长的织物布条。

sentences.en: When they followed it up, they saw it was attached to a beam in the roof.
sentences.zh: 顺着它往上找，他们看到它系在屋顶的一根梁上。

sentences.en: It had been used to tie around Shannon's waist when Donovan had to go out.
sentences.zh: 当多诺万不得不外出时，它曾被用来绑在香农的腰上。

sentences.en: She could reach the bathroom and the bed, and that's about it they also found a handwritten list of rules it read you must not make any noise
sentences.zh: 她只能够到浴室和床，差不多也就这样了。他们还发现了一份手写的规矩清单，上面写着：你绝不能发出任何声音

sentences.en: or bang your feet you must not go near the windows you must not get anything or do anything
sentences.zh: 或跺脚，你绝不能靠近窗户，没有我在场

sentences.en: without me being here keep the tv volume low only up to eight or lower you can play the super mario
sentences.zh: 你绝不能拿任何东西或做任何事。把电视音量调小，最高只能到八档或更低。你可以玩超级马里奥

sentences.en: games and you can play some dvds and you can play the cd music it ended with the letters ipu which stood for I promise you.
sentences.zh: 游戏，你可以看一些DVD，你可以听CD音乐。最后是以字母ipu结尾，代表“我向你保证”（I promise you）。

sentences.en: Amongst some of the things Shannon had been playing with in the flat they found a copy of a children's magazine called Arrive Alive.
sentences.zh: 在香农在公寓里玩的一些东西中，他们发现了一本名为《一路平安》（Arrive Alive）的儿童杂志副本。

sentences.en: It was a colourful book for kids on travelling safely.
sentences.zh: 这是一本为儿童编写的关于安全出行的色彩鲜艳的书。

sentences.en: The book explains to children to make sure people know where they are going and recommends that they always choose the safest route.
sentences.zh: 这本书向孩子们解释要确保别人知道他们要去哪里，并建议他们总是选择最安全的路线。

sentences.en: In the bedroom police found two packed bags of clothes by the door.
sentences.zh: 在卧室里，警方在门边发现了两个打包好的衣物袋。

sentences.en: With the packed clothes, the cash and the travel sickness medication, it was clear that Donovan was about to flee.
sentences.zh: 看着打包好的衣服、现金和晕车药，很明显多诺万正准备逃跑。

sentences.en: A check of his police record showed that he had been arrested for abducting his own daughter just over a year before, but the case was withdrawn from
sentences.zh: 对他的警方记录的检查显示，就在一年多前，他曾因绑架自己的女儿而被捕，但由于社会福利部门的介入，该案从

sentences.en: the courts after social services got involved.
sentences.zh: 法院撤诉了。

sentences.en: Police believed that Donovan was preparing to leave as the heat around Shannon's disappearance hadn't gone away.
sentences.zh: 警方认为，由于围绕香农失踪事件的舆论压力一直没有消散，多诺万正准备离开。

sentences.en: They believed he was intending to take Shannon with him, and if he did, the likelihood of her ever being found alive would have been very slim.
sentences.zh: 他们相信他打算把香农带走，如果他真的这么做了，她活着被找到的可能性将微乎其微。

sentences.en: Shannon's father, Leon Rose, was informed Shannon had been found.
sentences.zh: 香农的父亲莱昂·罗斯被告知香农已经被找到了。

sentences.en: He described the moment as feeling like he had won the lottery.
sentences.zh: 他形容那一刻的感觉就像中彩票一样。

sentences.en: He thanked everyone that helped in the search, saying he was just so thankful she was home.
sentences.zh: 他感谢了所有参与搜寻的人，并表示他非常感激她能回家。

sentences.en: Julie Bushby was at the community centre when she got the call.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·布什比接到电话时正在社区中心。

sentences.en: She started yelling that Shannon had been found.
sentences.zh: 她开始大喊香农被找到了。

sentences.en: The cheering could be heard down the road and people came rushing.
sentences.zh: 欢呼声沿着马路都能听到，人们纷纷赶来。

sentences.en: The residents hugged each other as they cried and shook their heads in disbelief.
sentences.zh: 居民们互相拥抱，流着眼泪，难以置信地摇着头。

sentences.en: No one could believe it.
sentences.zh: 没有人敢相信这是真的。

sentences.en: There were yet to be any questions.
sentences.zh: 还没有人提出任何问题。

sentences.en: Everyone was just glad to hear Shannon was okay.
sentences.zh: 大家只是很高兴听到香农没事。

sentences.en: Word quickly spread and soon text messages and calls were flying all over that Shannon had been found.
sentences.zh: 消息迅速传开，很快，香农被找到的短信和电话满天飞。

sentences.en: Karen's neighbours ran to her house and screamed out the news.
sentences.zh: 凯伦的邻居跑向她的房子，大声喊出这个消息。

sentences.en: Karen stared, frozen, and then burst into tears.
sentences.zh: 凯伦目瞪口呆，僵在原地，随后放声大哭。

sentences.en: As did Craig.
sentences.zh: 克雷格也是如此。

sentences.en: Back at
sentences.zh: 回到

sentences.en: Dewsbury Police Station, they were also celebrating.
sentences.zh: 迪斯伯里警察局，他们也在庆祝。

sentences.en: Detective Superintendent Andy Brennan described it as like nothing he had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 侦探总督察安迪·布伦南形容这简直是他从未见过的景象。

sentences.en: Quote, everyone was in tears.
sentences.zh: 引用原话：“所有人都哭了。”

sentences.en: I've never seen an incident room like it.
sentences.zh: “我从未见过这样的事件指挥室。”

sentences.en: It was a very emotional time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常情绪激动的时刻。

sentences.en: The vast majority of staff and officers were parents or grandparents themselves.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数工作人员和警官自己也都是父母或祖父母。

sentences.en: They didn't need anyone to remind them of the consequences of not finding Shannon.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要任何人来提醒他们找不到香农的后果。

sentences.en: News footage of Karen and Craig outside their house showed them shell-shocked.
sentences.zh: 新闻画面显示，凯倫和克雷格在房外显得惊魂未定。

sentences.en: Karen clutched Craig and turned her face away from the cameras in a way she hadn't done in the 24 days before.
sentences.zh: 凯倫紧紧抓着克雷格，把脸别开，避开摄像机，这是过去24天里她从未有过的举动。

sentences.en: At one point during the live news broadcast, Julie Bushby, who was inside the house, was yelling, Smile, woman.
sentences.zh: 在一次直播新闻中，身处屋内的朱莉·巴斯比大喊：“笑啊，女人。”

sentences.en: Why isn't she smiling?
sentences.zh: 她为什么不笑？

sentences.en: Some of her other friends also joined him.
sentences.zh: 她的一些其他朋友也加入了进来。

sentences.en: For God's sake, Karen, smile.
sentences.zh: 看在上帝的份上，凯倫，笑一个。

sentences.en: Karen turned back to the camera and smiled.
sentences.zh: 凯倫转过头对着镜头笑了笑。

sentences.en: At that moment, you could hear the crowd inside the house cheering.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，能听到屋里的人群在欢呼。

sentences.en: It wasn't just Morside celebrating.
sentences.zh: 不只是莫尔赛德在庆祝。

sentences.en: People came from all over the area.
sentences.zh: 人们从四面八方赶来。

sentences.en: They tore up the missing posters and danced around the streets.
sentences.zh: 他们撕毁了寻人启事，在街上跳起舞来。

sentences.en: The relief felt by the community was undeniable.
sentences.zh: 社区居民如释重负的心情显而易见。

sentences.en: People found it hard to control their emotions.
sentences.zh: 人们很难控制自己的情绪。

sentences.en: They felt proud of the way their community had pulled together and showed their strength.
sentences.zh: 他们为社区能够团结一心并展现出的力量感到骄傲。

sentences.en: In total, the search for Shannon Matthews cost £3.2 million and involved over 300 police officers.
sentences.zh: 寻找香农·马修斯的搜寻工作总共耗资320万英镑，出动了300多名警察。

sentences.en: Karen's house was full of people when police arrived, and they asked everyone to give them some privacy.
sentences.zh: 警察到达时，凯倫的家里挤满了人，他们要求所有人给他们留出一些私密空间。

sentences.en: When the officers confirmed the details of Shannon's rescue, Craig's eyes filled up and he cried.
sentences.zh: 当警官确认香农获救的细节时，克雷格眼里噙满了泪水，哭了起来。

sentences.en: Karen turned her face away, hiding her emotion.
sentences.zh: 凯倫转过脸去，掩饰着自己的情绪。

sentences.zh: 警官主动提出开车送凯倫和

sentences.zh: 克雷格去警局看望香农。

sentences.zh: 正当凯倫收拾东西时，警官们以为这位焦虑的母亲会对女儿抛出一连串的问题。

sentences.en: But they never came.
